newsitem.title: USA: Fallen tree injures 12 kids at Texas summer carnival.
newsitem.headline: Fallen tree injures 12 kids at Texas summer carnival.

text.p: At least 12 children were injured, two seriously, when a huge tree limb fell onto them during a summer carnival at Waco in central Texas Thursday.
Police and witnesses said the limb, almost as big as the rest of the tree, broke off and fell onto a group of about 35 children as they stood in line for a dunking booth.
"The tree just collapsed and injured 12 children," police spokeswoman Sharon Lavender said.
Fire crews pulled children from under the collapsed limb and rushed them to hospitals. Officials said at least two were in serious condition.
It was not clear why the tree collapsed. A storm hit the area two nights ago but Thursday was a glorious summer day.
About 500 children from area day-care centres were attending the carnival at Waco's Bledsoe Miller Community Centre.
